speaker: Mr Zainal Sapari
text: asked	the Minister for National Development (a) whether HDB can review the eligible income criteria for HDB rental flats, especially for families with children affected by divorce settlements; and (b) whether HDB can give special priority to families with school-going children in applications for HDB rental flats or units under the Sale of Balance Flats scheme.

speaker: Mr Zainal Sapari (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: My follow-up question is: can HDB give priority to families who are not purchasing from the SBF scheme as a first purchase?

speaker: Mr Zainal Sapari
text: Would priority be given to these families as well?

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: Second-timers have already owned an HDB flat before and so, in that instance, they will not be given priority above first-timers.
